title: Sunset Lines: The Story of the Chicago Aurora & Elgin Railroad (Volume 2 - History)
author: Larry Plachno
description: This book covers the history and details of the Chicago Aurora & Elgin Railroad, including its trackage, management under different leaders such as Dr. Thomas Conway Jr., Samuel Insull, etc., operations involving freight services, passenger service suspension, scrapping equipment, rail removals during 1962-1963.
